items.text: Nearly all productive assets, from farmland to factories, should be owned in common, by those who work them or by the whole community.
items.note: Productive assets: things used to make goods or provide services, such as land, factories, machines and companies.
items.rationale: Core socialist/anarcho-communist claim, agentless; 'nearly all' matches col-06's scope; draft col-01.

items.text: The gap in wealth between a society's richest and poorest people should be small.
items.rationale: Egalitarian clear lean (not strict equality); exact mirror of col-07; review rewrite of draft col-05.

items.text: If only one provider can supply an essential service, such as piped water, it should be owned by the public or its users.
items.rationale: Natural-monopoly condition favours Collective; mirror of col-08; 'power' dropped as ambiguous.

items.text: Large companies should be owned by their workers or by the public.
items.rationale: Covers both co-operativists and public-ownership socialists; exact mirror of col-09.

items.text: If a small group comes to own most of a society's wealth, much of it should be shared out among the rest.
items.rationale: Concentration condition favours Collective; 'much' matches col-10's 'almost all'; draft col-06 tightened.

items.text: Nearly all productive assets, from farmland to factories, should be owned privately, by individuals, families or investors.
items.note: Productive assets: things used to make goods or provide services, such as land, factories, machines and companies.
items.rationale: Exact mirror of col-01; drops 'land' (parks, roads) and 'businesses they form' (admits co-ops).

items.text: A large gap in wealth between a society's richest and poorest people is acceptable.
items.rationale: Exact mirror of col-02; now a true rule (draft col-12 was a hidden conditional).

items.text: If a publicly or commonly owned enterprise runs at a loss year after year, it should be sold to private owners.
items.rationale: Failure condition favours Private; mirror of col-03; likely frame split.

items.text: Large companies should be owned by private shareholders.
items.rationale: Exact mirror of col-04; rescoped from 'most businesses' (near-consensus small firms).

items.text: If people grow rich by selling things others freely choose to buy, they should keep almost all of that wealth.
items.rationale: Voluntary-exchange condition favours Private; 'almost all' lifts draft col-13 off consensus.
